reviews.text: Good shop, you can find what you need. The staff are always attentive and give excellent advice!
I wanted to give it 4.5 stars but it wasn't possible so I'll leave it at 4.
My cats love Purina Pro Plan gravy bites, especially the gravy!

I went there to pick up my click and collect order, but they didn't have the treats I needed, and there weren't many left in the store due to a delivery problem. However, it wasn't the team's fault; I want to emphasize that the two young women and the young man were particularly pleasant and professional. There's nothing to complain about at Animalis; you're always well received. 🐾

Nice place, not very big and managable.
Good quality and friendly staff

Very convenient store next to Monoprix.
Staff are very friendly and helpful.
Excellent store, the service is impeccable and very kind. Thanks to you, my Mimi is in good health.
Very good, the staff are always pleasant and the store is clean. Just the prices are a bit high on some products, but it does the job.

Thank you to the staff for being so welcoming!
I'd like to thank the salesperson who advised me on cages, treats, and stress relief for my cat!
The store was very well organized and clean, with a professional welcome and friendly staff.
Correct
Lovely staff
Great store

A true pleasure to visit this cat and dog paradise!

Moreover, the staff are lovely, competent, available, and attentive to the customer. I highly recommend it.
The shop is small but well-stocked. Friendly welcome and good advice.
A very warm welcome and a well-run shop. Many thanks to Teliau who was very helpful, attentive, and provided excellent advice.
A very pleasant and convenient store with a very friendly and professional team.
The staff were welcoming and gave us time to look at what we were looking for.

The staff is lovely, a welcome change from some other stores in the chain. I'm not giving it 5 stars because the prices are still a bit high. But I'll definitely be back to stock up on products I can only find there.
Alright

Overall, I'm quite disappointed with my experiences at Animalis.

I often have to go back and forth because the products I regularly buy are very frequently out of stock (Royal Canin kibble, Applaws wet food, etc.).
I've also twice received rather inappropriate remarks such as, "It's all well and good to buy vet products, but if you're also giving Whiskas treats, it's pointless," or persistent attempts to get me to switch from my usual kibble to their own brand, Nath. The sales pitch is sometimes a bit too aggressive for my liking.

Finally, although this concerns the delivery service more than the store itself, I placed a large order of €160 last week. It was sent in two packages: one is marked as delivered even though I never received it, and the other has been stuck "in transit" since yesterday and also seems to be lost... In short, a rather frustrating experience overall.
Awesome team

Great selection of pet products and the best price on Royal Canin Persian cat food we have found. We have Maine coons, but they love the Persian dry food, and the Maine coon food is so large that a lot of it is reduced to crumbs that are wasted.

Also the closest store to us in the Marais.

The store is quite well-stocked and clean. The staff are very friendly and take the time to explain everything without pressuring you to buy anything, especially the most expensive items. I found some new treats that my cat LOVES! I'll definitely be back.
A small, convenient local Animalis store with very pleasant, attentive, and competent staff.
A fairly large space with a good selection
Excellent service

I usually go to the Bercy drive-through, but this time the items weren't available. I picked up my order at Traversière. I was very disappointed with the calfskin clogs: small and split. Nothing like the ones the Bercy store makes for me.
I won't be going back.
Very competent and friendly saleswomen

Mr. Laurent Benoit,

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We are delighted to see that you were completely satisfied with your experience at Animalis Paris 12 - Traversière. Your positive feedback is a real source of motivation for our team.

We hope to welcome you back very soon to continue providing you with service that meets your expectations. If you have any questions or need further information, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Sincerely,
The Animalis Paris 12 - Traversière Team

I went to pick up my order for my cat (Royal Canin wet food), and the salesperson told me that I only buy name brands and that there are other brands (Edgar Cooper, Nat) that are much higher quality and less expensive. He also specified that it doesn't matter whether it's labeled Kitten, Kitten Sterilised, or Adult.

I want to point out that brands like Royal Canin are the only ones to publish scientific and regulated studies and to have Research and Development centers. Such advice, which goes against all the recommendations of veterinarians (who have studied and know the animal in question, unlike this salesperson), is very dangerous.
Very professional and friendly staff. Clean, well-organized and fairly large store.

Dear Janaína,

We would like to thank you warmly for your 5-star review of our Animalis Paris 12 - Traversière location. Your satisfaction is our priority, and your positive feedback encourages us to continue providing excellent service to our customers and their four-legged companions.

If you require any further advice or assistance regarding our products or services, please do not hesitate to visit us or contact us. We would be delighted to help.

Thank you again for your support, Janaína, and we hope to welcome you back very soon.

Sincerely,
The Animalis Paris 12 - Traversière Team

I followed your advice and bought the KONG Pop-Up Cat House, and indeed my 12kg Maine Coon fits right in and is having a blast.

So thank you for your advice and the kindness of the whole team.

CK

Dear Patricia Arnaud,

Thank you so much for your review and this wonderful 5-star rating! The entire Animalis Paris 12 - Traversière team is delighted to know that your experience with us met your expectations.

Your satisfaction is our priority, and your compliments encourage us to continue providing you with excellent service. If you have any questions or need advice about your pets, please don't hesitate to contact us; we're here to help.

Sincerely,
Your Animalis Paris 12 - Traversière Team
Convenient. You can find everything. And not too expensive.

Dear Carole Garcia,

Thank you so much for your five-star review of our Animalis Paris 12 - Traversière location. Your satisfaction is our priority, and we are delighted to know that your experience met your expectations.

Please don't hesitate to visit us again. Our team will be happy to welcome you back and assist you with your pet-related projects. If you have any suggestions or specific needs, we are here to listen and provide you with the best possible service.

Thank you again for your trust, Carole Garcia.

Sincerely,

The Animalis Paris 12 - Traversière Team
Good local shop, everything for our pets

I just moved in two weeks ago and went to this pet store near my new place. I have several pets (cats, a dog, and rodents), and I was greeted by a young woman (I think I saw her name on her clothes, Lisa), and frankly, she's so passionate. Super friendly, very attentive, and I left with my pet food, of course, but also some other accessories I hadn't even thought of myself! I'll definitely be back. A very pleasant store overall :-) See you soon!

A very nice store, very convenient for people who live nearby.
The staff are very friendly and attentive. ✨

One of the cashiers was not only unfriendly, unkind, and unrespectful, but I also had to learn her job.

I've been an Animalis customer for a very long time, and this is the first time I've changed stores, and I shouldn't have.
She doesn't even know that we have the option to round up our purchases for the animals and charities they support.

"What?", "What's that?" In short, very disrespectful and unfriendly.
When you open stores, make sure you hire friendly cashiers who at least know the brand.
I'm now sticking with the franchise in the 13th arrondissement; at least they're respectful and don't have any prejudice against a person with reduced mobility.

My package arrived damaged and the store clerk immediately called me to let me know and find a solution with me. Once there, the contact was more than friendly; you can tell you're dealing with passionate people!
The salesperson was very friendly and helpful. A well-stocked new shop in Paris.

Dear Pavlo Kozyn,

Thank you so much for taking the time to share your experience and for your 4-star rating. We are delighted to hear that your visit to Animalis Paris 12 - Traversière was generally satisfactory. Your feedback is invaluable to us, as it helps us continuously improve to better meet your expectations.

If you have any specific suggestions or aspects of your visit that you think we could improve, please don't hesitate to let us know. We would be happy to hear your ideas and incorporate them to offer an even better experience for our customers.

We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back to our store soon.

Sincerely,

The Animalis Paris 12 - Traversière Team

Dear RC,

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! Your satisfaction is our priority, and your positive feedback is the best reward for our team. We are delighted that your experience at Animalis Paris 12 - Traversière met your expectations.

Please don't hesitate to come back and see us again. Our team will be happy to welcome you back and provide you with the best possible service.

See you soon at Animalis,

The Animalis Paris 12 - Traversière Team

Overall, it was very good, except that the promised dog gift turned out to be conditional on something or other when I picked up my purchase in store. The very friendly person who helped me gave it to me anyway.

I generally like the Animalis brand: a good selection of products online and in-store; reasonable prices.

I'm delighted that a store has opened in my neighborhood, and the staff is very welcoming and helpful.
I loved this well-organized store with everything I needed for my pets!!
A warm welcome awaits you at this new pet shop.
Great store with lots of choice and excellent advice from the sales staff!

I went to the store to find some Virbac pet food, and the sales assistant suggested we place a click and collect order together. Very convenient for me, as I don't like entering my bank details on websites. Three days later, I received an email informing me that my package had arrived at the store. I went to pick it up, and I even received a free gift. Thanks again to the sales assistant!

Very happy with my visit today.

20% off opening offer.

A young and dynamic team who went above and beyond to meet my cat's specific veterinary needs.

I was already familiar with the brand, having shopped at other stores in Paris.

The shop is very beautiful, bright, and has a wide selection.

I bought two small balls there.

However, I was disappointed by the checkout process. The staff was friendly, but once I'd paid, they asked me:

"Oh, I forgot, do you have a loyalty account?"

I said yes, and they simply told me: "Well, it's too late."

The result: no loyalty points. I wouldn't even have noticed if they hadn't told me. In that case, why mention it if there's no solution offered?

It's a shame, because it leaves a rather frustrating impression after an experience that had started so well.
What a store! Pleasant and well-organized. With a warm welcome and friendly staff. I highly recommend it.

Excellent store, friendly and helpful staff who take the time to answer questions.
Thank you to the salesperson on Saturday evening.
Is this new? Great, I can't wait to go!
Beautiful, spacious and well-stocked shop with friendly staff

Visited today, a Sunday which was very convenient for me as I work all week.
A fantastic welcome from the two sales assistants and the exceptional cashier.

I hope we'll see him in the store more often.

Here's a little photo of said cashier 😉.
